answer: Established-peer gating: only identities that already hold established standing can vote or attest, and that standing is earned only through sustained honest work settled across many epochs, never granted at signup. A clone farm inherits nothing; each fake must independently grind its own multi-epoch record before its attestation carries any ripple. So 1000 sybils mean 1000 separate work-streams, each climbing from a cold mesa and a dead ember upward. Cost scales strictly linearly with farm size, and a dormant clone never crosses the threshold at all.
